description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc class, testing its methods for retrieving supported MIME types and checking MIME type support via IPC mechanisms. It uses Google Test framework and mocks IPC channel interactions.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpcTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc, inheriting from IpcModuleBase and Google Test's Test class. It sets up mock IPC interactions and provides helper methods for testing.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Initializes the MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc object and expects successful IPC initialization.

methods.name: setGetSupportedMimeTypesResponse
methods.description: Sets the mock response for getSupportedMimeTypes IPC call with predefined MIME types.
